lesson.plain_english: who can approve, access, trigger, delete, escalate, or spend when an AI agent starts acting
lesson.big_question: Is the product the agent, or the power to decide what the agent is allowed to do?
lesson.simple_analogy: the remote control for what an AI agent is allowed to touch, approve, buy, or break
lesson.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson.hard_receipt: AI in Life Science Market worth $69.34 billion by 2031
lesson.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand permission layer well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson.episode_spine: AI in Life Science Market worth $69.34 billion by 2031 is really about who controls what agents are allowed to do.
